text: Hi Nassim, just checking in on the new site preview (https://azwebcorp.com/preview/prestige-v2) — everything's built and audited, so the only things holding us back from going live are on your side: your logo file, the manufacturer brand logos (Shaw, Daltile, MSI, etc.) for the Featured Brands strip, and a few real photos of your showroom/completed jobs to swap out the stock images. Whenever you can send those over, we can flip it live the next day. Also still need your call on the ~5,400 supplier catalogue product pages on your current site — rebuild them, replace with a simpler product browser, or leave them behind? No rush, just want to keep this moving whenever you're ready.
